en: Kukuku... Been a while.
Aragi!!

jp: 不用意に飛び出すべきではない
en: Wait!! Don't go rushing in carelessly.

jp: 待ちかまえていたのなら
何かしら罠があるはずだ
en: If he went to the trouble of waiting for us here, there must be some kind of trap.

jp: 罠ってのは、こいつらのことか？
en: ...A trap? You mean these guys here?

jp: フシュルルルルル・・・
en: Fshhhrrrrrr...
Pasca!?

jp: お前には別のお友達がいるぜ？
en: Oh, right. You've got a different friend here, don't you?

jp: わざわざ殺されに来たのか？
en: ...Hmph. You came all this way to be killed?
Abel... Ugh!?

jp: どうせまた、翼が痛むんだろ？
en: Don't push yourself. Your wings hurt again, don't they?

jp: さっきまでは何ともなかったのに
en: Why... They were fine just a moment ago...

jp: ザイオンからあの話は聞いたか？
en: Luca. Did Zion tell you about that little matter?
...What matter?

jp: 話してやってないのか？
en: Kukuku... What's this, Zion? You haven't told her?
...Shut up.

jp: お前が一番、ルカに死んで
欲しくないと思っているんだろ？
en: Quit acting tough. You're the one who least wants Luca to die, aren't you?
Shut up!!
Me, die?

jp: なんでアタシが死ななきゃ
en: Don't be stupid. Why would I have to die!?

jp: 死ぬのはあんただよ、アラギ
en: You're the one who's going to die, Aragi.
HYAA-HAHAHA! Me, die?
You're the ones who'll die.

jp: くっくっくっ・・・・・・
en: Kukuku...... That's how it is.

jp: まだ聞きたいことがあるんだ！！
en: Wait! I still have things to ask you!!

jp: アベル、キミは何者なの？
どうしてボクやマティアを
en: Abel, who are you? How do you know about me and Matia?

jp: キミはいったい・・・
en: Who are you, really...

jp: それをオレに聞くのか？
en: You're asking me that?

jp: ボクには小さな頃の記憶がない
en: I have no memories of when I was little.

jp: ボクの知らない子供の頃の記憶
もしかしてキミは・・・
en: The childhood I can't remember... were you there? Could you be...

jp: ボクの兄弟？なんて聞くなよ
考えただけでも虫酸が走る
en: Don't ask if I'm your brother. The very thought makes my skin crawl.

jp: 近くにいながら最も遠い存在
en: So close, yet the furthest thing from you. Light and shadow.
Light and shadow?

jp: そう、オレと同じで・・・
en: That's right. Just like me... you were tainted long ago.
Matia poisoned your mind, that's all. You just can't remember.

jp: 本当の自分の姿を・・・
en: What you truly are...
I don't know anything about that.
I'm me! There's no true or false about it!

jp: 本当にそう言い切れるのか？
en: Can you really say that for certain?

jp: オレの顔を見ただけで
en: When just seeing my face shakes you up like this?
I'm not shaken...
Ugh!?

jp: 翼の力を使うどころか
en: With a heart that weak, forget using the wings' power. They'll eat you alive.
Eat me alive?

jp: お喋りが過ぎたか・・・
en: I've talked too much... Oh well.
Die, Cain!
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
